name: Defense Plug-In C
main_effect:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.), ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.), and can't be deleted by your opponent's effects.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with a play cost of 4 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, add this card to its owner's hand.
